title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Liquid Web /…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Liquid Web / StellarWP Event Tickets plugin versions up to 5.31.1. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The flaw affects the Event Tickets plugin and has a CVSS score of 7.1, indicating a high severity risk.
